title: FCD Scale Normalization & Reference Alignment
context: Root-cause analysis shows FCD fails when ref and def frames have different carrier periods (e.g. 14% mismatch in 4.21-expt/10-1: ref=60px, def=52px). Also flatfield_sigma is image-size-independent but should scale with image dimensions. Goal: add preprocessing so FCD works correctly on cross-scale datasets without breaking existing 20Hz/s2 correctness.

stories.title: Scale normalization module
stories.description: Add openfcd/core/registration.py with scale_normalize_reference() that detects carrier period mismatch and rescales ref to match def
acceptanceCriteria: File openfcd/core/registration.py exists with scale_normalize_reference(ref_ff, def_ff, carriers_ref) -> (aligned_ref_ff, aligned_carriers)
When periods match within 3% tolerance, returns ref_ff unchanged
When periods differ >3%, rescales ref by zoom(ref, period_def/period_ref) and recomputes carriers
Returns (aligned_ref_ff, carriers) tuple
Module imports cleanly: `from openfcd.core.registration import scale_normalize_reference`
Unit test verifies: synthetic test with 2 different-scale images produces normalized output with matching carrier periods within 3%

stories.title: Integrate scale normalization into _compute_single_frame
stories.description: Wire scale_normalize_reference into the FCD pipeline so it runs before carrier-based processing
acceptanceCriteria: _compute_single_frame in cmd_run.py calls scale_normalize_reference after flatfield and before inpaint/FCD
A new project setting process.auto_scale_ref: bool = True controls whether normalization runs
When auto_scale_ref=True and scale deviation >3%, ref_ff is rescaled before inpaint/FCD steps
When auto_scale_ref=False, behavior is identical to before
scale_warning is logged (Python logging.warning) when scale deviation exceeds 10%
AST parse of cmd_run.py and project.py succeeds after changes

stories.title: Adaptive flatfield sigma
stories.description: flatfield_sigma should scale proportionally with image size. Add process.flatfield_sigma_auto: bool = True that overrides sigma = max(image_dimension) * 0.06 (covers ~1 carrier period for typical BOS setups)
acceptanceCriteria: When flatfield_sigma_auto=True (default), effective sigma = max(H,W) * 0.06, clamped to [100, 2000]
When flatfield_sigma_auto=False, uses process.flatfield_sigma as before
For 1280x1024 image: effective sigma ≈ 77 (clamped to 100)
For 5568x3712 image: effective sigma ≈ 334
ProjectModel schema parses both old and new projects (backwards compatible)
AST parse succeeds on all modified files

stories.title: Carrier mismatch diagnostic in GUI
stories.description: Show a warning in the status bar and properties panel when the selected reference frame has a significantly different carrier period from the first deformed frame
acceptanceCriteria: When _on_compute_frame is triggered, compute carrier period of ref and frame
If mismatch >10%: status bar shows 'Warning: scale mismatch X%' before computation starts
If mismatch >10%: single QMessageBox.warning prompt with explanation and continue/cancel options
If mismatch <=10%: no warning shown, proceeds normally
AST parse of mainwindow.py succeeds

stories.title: Regression: 20Hz/s2 correctness preserved
stories.description: Verify existing tests still pass and scale normalization does not corrupt the well-behaved dataset
acceptanceCriteria: pytest tests/ passes (all existing tests green)
scale_normalize_reference on two 20Hz/s2 frames (same carrier period) returns ref unchanged (scale=1.0, deviation<3%)
python -c 'from openfcd.cli.cmd_run import _compute_single_frame; print("ok")' succeeds
